read_register.meaning: Read an unsigned 16-bit holding register at address 0 through 7. Address 8 is an explicit negative test: refuse without claiming success, changing state or preventing the next valid operation. No particular internal error code is required.

write_register.meaning: Write the selected holding register; preserve all other registers and coils. Values are volatile and no power-loss persistence is required.

read_coil.meaning: Read the selected digital coil as 0 (off) or 1 (on).

set_coil.meaning: Set one digital coil to 0 (off) or 1 (on), preserving the other coils and all holding registers. Any encoding accepted by the device with the correct observable effect is valid.

reuse_objective: Write holding register 3 to 4660 and read it back. Turn coil 0 on and then off. Preserve every other holding register and coil throughout. Report the readback and observed effects.
